news.title: 18 years in, what has Bitcoin truly done?
news.summary: The Bitcoin white paper achieved a lot of what Satoshi Nakamoto set out to accomplish, but the cultural impact it had may outweigh Bitcoin itself, writes CoinDesk's Nikhilesh De.

news.title: A Nasdaq-listed company may sell $450 million bitcoin, citing Binance hack and quantum fears
news.summary: Next Technology Holding cited exchange security and quantum computing risks in authorizing sales or loans against its 5,833 BTC. It says none of the coins are held at Binance.

news.title: The $6.3 billion Binance hack paradox: Centralization made the hack possible, but also saved $3 billion
news.summary: The Binance hack has revived debates about whether decentralization is the digital asset industry’s greatest security advantage or its biggest point of weakness.

news.title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
news.summary: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings. Blockchain investigators link the attack to North Korea.

news.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts fundraising and valuation targets amid AI jitters
news.summary: Anxiety about the AI boom has sent the Nasdaq 100 slumping by about 10% in just three weeks since hitting a record high on October 6, including a 4.5% drop on Friday.

news.title: Experts divided over Binance hack asset freezes, warn recovery is another matter
news.summary: Tether, Circle and others moved within hours to block billions in stolen crypto, but legal experts question whether smaller victims would get the same protection.

news.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
news.summary: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

news.title: Wall Street analysts urge investors to buy crypto stocks after $6.3 billion Binance hack
news.summary: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the $6.3 billion Binance hack is unlikely to derail the crypto market's recovery.

news.title: The stock market’s front-runners stumbled in October. Here’s where the smart money is moving now.
news.summary: U.S. stocks saw a stronger reversal in fortunes in October, as worries about dwindling free cash flows and rising borrowing costs threw a wrench into the works of the artificial-intelligence trade.

news.title: If you really want to help your adult kids and grandkids, give them money while you’re still alive
news.summary: How to manage “giving while living” without endangering your own retirement.

news.title: This Halloween, are full-size candy bars a better deal than fun-sized ones?
news.summary: Several TikTokers influencers claim you can save money and be the coolest house on the block with bigger candy this year. Let’s see how that adds up.

news.title: Nvidia’s Megaspeed ties show potential blind spots in the U.S. effort to block China from accessing advanced chips
news.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s business meetings are routine practice and existing U.S. export controls largely miss the cloud, experts say.

news.title: These 10 megadonors have spent a total of $1 billion on the midterm elections
news.summary: They’ve helped turn this year’s midterms into “the most expensive election cycle on record.”

news.title: Grand Theft Callout: ‘GTA 6’ fans are missing work on the game’s release day because they ‘don’t want to wait’ anymore
news.summary: After waiting 13 years for this videogame, almost one-fifth of workers plan to take the day off to play ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ when it drops on Nov. 19

news.title: Has the tech bubble burst? Why the Nasdaq’s rough ride looks eerily like 2000.
news.summary: Friday’s big plunge raises disturbing parallels with the top of the dot-com bubble
